title: Pin & Promote Flow for Composite Quant Variants (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We frequently onboard model weight variants produced by different quantization toolchains (INT8 static, AWQ, GPTQ, FP8 mixed) but lack a single canonical flow to pin, validate, and promote these composite variants into serving channels. This creates brittle rollouts, inconsistent telemetry, and ad-hoc rollback behavior.

Goal: Implement a unified Pin & Promote flow that: 1) accepts composite quant artifacts (weights + quant metadata + profile), 2) executes deterministic canary checks against a standard eval set and SLO smoke tests, 3) produces a promotion artifact with immutable pin metadata, and 4) exposes automated rollback and audit logs when regressions are detected.

Scope: In-scope: artifact schema, ingestion API, deterministic canary runner, SLO-aware promotion gating, release metadata (pin manifest), dashboards/alerts for regressions, automated fallback policy. Out-of-scope: model training improvements and quant toolchain changes.

Success criteria: 
- New pin manifest schema adopted by the intake service and the runtime (manifest pinned on deploys).
- Canary pipeline detects >95% of injected perf regressions on the standard eval corpus (measured on historical regressions).
- Promotion to 'pinned' channel requires X successful canaries and SLO pass for latency & accuracy metrics.
- Automatic rollback triggers and rollback playbook exercised in one staged rollout by release date.

Non-goals: Replacing existing pin registry UI in Console (Frontend follow-up), changing tenant-level routing policies (separate project).
acceptance_criteria: Artifact manifest schema defined and documented in Confluence (link below).
Intake API accepts composite quant bundles with required metadata and returns deterministic artifact id + pin token.
Canary runner reproduces perf/latency tests headlessly with seeded RNG and fixed batching profile.
Promotion step writes immutable pin to pin-registry and annotates runtime with variant fingerprint.
On-detected regression, rollback policy triggers fallback to previous compatible pin within 5 minutes and emits paged alert.
telemetry: Canary pass rate (per-variant) - metric: quant.canary.pass_rate - dashboard: QuantOnboarding / Canary Overview.
Regression delta distribution (accuracy & downstream NLL) - metric: quant.regression.delta - alert if mean delta > threshold.
Serving latency P50/P95 for pinned vs baseline - metrics: runtime.latency.p50/p95 - used for SLO gating.
Pin promotion events (audit) - logs have fields: artifact_id, pin_token, promoted_by, canary_snapshot_id.
Rollback incidents - linked to PagerDuty runbook and postmortem template.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Lab): implement schema + intake API, local emulation tests (team-only).
Phase 1 (Canary): run canaries for non-critical models with 10% traffic using 'staged-pin' channel for 2 weeks.
Phase 2 (Promotion): enable automated promotion for supported quant toolchains (INT8/GPTQ/AWQ/FP8) after stable telemetry for 2 successful cycles.
Phase 3 (Enforce): require pin manifest on all production deploys for tenant-tier Dedicated and Hosted.
test_plan: Unit tests for manifest validation and pin token issuance.
Integration tests that upload sample bundles (INT8, GPTQ, AWQ, FP8) and run end-to-end canary harness in CI.
Introduce synthetic regressions (known deltas) to verify canary sensitivity and alerting pipeline.
Chaos test: simulate partial KV cache loss and ensure rollback chooses compatible variant and preserves session continuity where possible.
